title: Extract a finite normal cover
statement: A finite family of finite intermediate algebras contained in the integral closure whose supremum has integrally closed prime localizations exists under the hypotheses of the patching lemma.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 0333, finite-family compactness and finite-supremum paragraphs

proof.text: This intermediate result is the compactness/localization part of the Stacks proof, isolated for the upper theorem.

from.place: decomposition of finite-family extraction and supremum patching

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finite_normal_cover (A : Type u) (K : Type v)
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    (hAway : ∃ f : A, f ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ (p : Ideal (Localization.Away f)) [p.IsPrime],
        IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime p) ∧ IsIntegrallyClosed (Localization.AtPrime p))
    (hLocal : ∀ (m : Ideal A) [m.IsMaximal],
      ∃ B : Subalgebra A K, B ≤ integralClosure A K ∧ Module.Finite A B ∧
        ∀ (q : Ideal B) [q.IsPrime], Ideal.comap (algebraMap A B) q = m →
          IsIntegrallyClosed (Localization.AtPrime q)) :
    ∃ s : Finset (Subalgebra A K), ∃ S : Subalgebra A K,
      S = s.sup (fun C : Subalgebra A K => C) ∧
      (∀ C ∈ s, C ≤ integralClosure A K ∧ Module.Finite A C) ∧
      ∀ (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime],
        IsIntegrallyClosed (Localization.AtPrime q)
